title: Physics closure: shortcut holonomies, dark-pair structure, localized Hodge cooling, gauge matter, Floquet Coulomb pumping, and three outside-box probes
purpose: Execute the five physics next steps after Passes 4041-4056 and add three independent outside-box physics constructions with executable falsifiers and strict evidence boundaries.
result: Exact finite-time counterdiabatic actions were derived for both non-Abelian holonomies; the complete 3161-dimensional contact-dark pair module was decomposed by reconstructing the 20-class character algebra of PSp(4,3); the dense Hodge polar map was reduced to an exact cubic local-query spectral transform; a gauge-covariant Wilson-Dirac tower removed fifteen doublers while exposing the unavoidable chirality boundary; and the irrational Floquet clock feeding static Coulomb ports obeyed an exact zero-DC no-pump theorem. Three additional constructions convert graph distance into irrational quasienergy, expose residual dark-pair entropy, and turn the Hodge index into a three-failure fault odometer.
coordination: Passes 4005-4056 and the parallel 4065-4072 namespace remain intact. The restored large website is protected through the manifest reconciler rather than edited directly.
boundary: Exact finite graph, group-character, projector, polynomial, lattice, Floquet, and canonical-ensemble statements only. No fabricated device, measured shortcut fidelity, mobile bound pair phase, reservoir implementation, chiral gauge theory, quantized pump, gravity, Standard Model, cosmology, or theory of everything is established.
